summary: N2 SiteSpec: mo hinh du lieu site va cong SITE-001 khoa G0. (1) contracts/site_hazard_profile.schema.json len 1.2 voi khoi geotechnical_investigation: ho khoan co toa do, do sau, dia tang tung lop, SPT-N theo do sau, muc nuoc ngam - dung thu ma G0 doi ma SITE-UNSPECIFIED.json de trong co chu dich. Giu nguyen tuong thich 1.0/1.1: ho so placeholder hien co van validate khong loi. (2) bridge_evolution/site/spec.py: bang RULE_INPUT_REQUIREMENTS khai TUNG NHOM RULE HA NGUON CAN TRUONG SITE NAO (HYDRO/SEIS/WIND/GEO/DUR) - day la hop dong, them mot rule hazard moi ma khong khai o day thi no se chay tren du lieu trong ma khong ai biet. check_site_readiness() phat SITE-001 HARD va NEU DICH DANH tung truong thieu kem trang thai, khong bao chung chung. (3) Phan biet ba trang thai khac nhau ma truoc day de bi gop: KNOWN (co bang chung), UNKNOWN (da khai la chua biet), MISSING (chua khai gi) - gop lai la mat thong tin. (4) n60(): hieu chinh SPT ve nang luong 60% theo CE/CR/CB/CS, ghi ro trong docstring rang day KHONG phai hieu chinh ung suat phu (N1)60. 19 test moi, gom test chan bia: ho so UNSPECIFIED_PLACEHOLDER khong duoc khai da khoan, va khong ham nao duoc dien gia tri mac dinh cho truong UNKNOWN.
assumptions: Module nay KHONG tinh hazard va KHONG duoc wire vao evaluate.py trong task nay - evaluate.py thuoc write_scope cua BRD-028. SITE-001 vi vay hien la mot ham co the goi duoc chu chua phai mot cong dang chan trong pipeline.
He so CE/CR/CB/CS cua n60 theo thuc hanh pho bien (Skempton 1986, FHWA GEC-5). Chua doi chieu voi mot vi du so cong bo cu the nao ngoai truong hop hien nhien energy_ratio=0.60.
unresolved_risks: bridge_evolution.site chua duoc them vao pyproject.toml packages nen chua vao wheel - cung loai loi dong goi nhu durability truoc day. Khong sua trong task nay vi pyproject.toml la artifact dang cho review cua BRD-029; can lam ngay sau khi BRD-029 dong.

RULE_INPUT_REQUIREMENTS hien do NGUOI khai bang tay. Neu ai do them rule HYDRO-002 can them mot truong site ma quen cap nhat bang nay thi rule do se chay tren du lieu thieu - can mot test doi chieu khi cac nhom rule hazard duoc viet that o N4.
